provenance.quote: PIXCLARA is a radioactive diagnostic drug indicated

sections.title: Mechanism of Action
sections.text: Floretyrosine F 18 is a radiolabeled derivative of tyrosine and a substrate for the Large Neutral Amino Acid Transporter 1 and 2 (LAT). LAT is a sodium-independent exchanger protein that transports large neutral amino acids (e.g., tyrosine, phenylalanine) across cell membranes, and it is highly expressed in the blood-brain barrier and glioma tumor tissue. Consequently, floretyrosine F 18 accumulates in cells that express LAT on their surface. Fluorine-18 is a β+ emitting radionuclide that enables positron emission tomography.

sections.title: Pharmacodynamics
sections.text: The relationship between floretyrosine F 18 plasma concentrations and image interpretation has not been characterized.

sections.title: Pharmacokinetics
sections.text: Distribution Following intravenous administration, floretyrosine F 18 distributes (% of injected activity) to skeletal muscles (39.2%), liver (3.1%), lungs (2.3%), bone marrow (2.2%), and brain (1.9%). Elimination Metabolism The majority of floretyrosine F 18 remains intact in plasma. At 60 minutes and 120 minutes post-injection, 91 ± 5% and 87% ± 13% of the total radioactivity in the plasma was intact floretyrosine F 18, respectively. Excretion Elimination is by urinary excretion. Approximately 22% of administered activity was excreted by 5 hours. Drug Interaction Studies In Vitro • Effect of Transporters on Floretyrosine: Floretyrosine is not a substrate for P-glycoprotein (P-gp), breast cancer resistance protein (BCRP), or bile salt export pump (BSEP). • Effect of Floretyrosine on CYP Enzymes: Floretyrosine does not inhibit or induce CYP1A2, CYP2B6, or CYP3A4. • Effect of Floretyrosine on Transporter Systems: Floretyrosine does not inhibit P-gp, BCRP, or BSEP.

indications.name: Use with positron emission tomography (PET) to differentiate recurrent or progressive glioma from treatment-related change, in conjunction with other diagnostic evaluations, in adults and pediatric patients 1 month of age and older

approvalProvenance.quote: Named in the ORIG-1 approval letter; first listed in the label on or before ORIG-1, absent from the last complete label before it.

approvals.statement: This NDA provides for the use of Pixclara (floretyrosine F 18) injection for use with positron emission tomography (PET) to differentiate recurrent or progressive glioma from treatment-related change, in conjunction with other diagnostic evaluations, in adults and pediatric patients 1 month of age and older.
